description: A context manager that collects other managers and callbacks at run time and unwinds them in reverse order.
Enters a context manager, registers its `__exit__` on the stack, and returns what `__enter__` returned.
`callback(f, *args)` registers a plain cleanup that cannot see the exception; `push(exit)` registers an `__exit__`-shaped function.
Moves every registered callback to a new `ExitStack` without running them: ownership transfer out of a `with` block.
Last registered, first closed, and every callback still runs when one of them raises.
